source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: If you choose Impossible Form for [Unearthly Power](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.magnus-the-red.unearthly-power) as a battle round begins, subtract 1 Damage from each attack made against Magnus through to the start of the next battle round. **[[PSYCHIC]](vsdata:weapon-ability/psychic)** attacks are exempt.
